channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Victorious Takaichi promises 'strong and prosperous' Japan
item.description: TOKYO: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi pledged Friday to make Japan “strong and prosperous“, while hitting out at China and pledging to keep “hitting the growth button” following her party landslide election win.

item.title: Cops says 'no foul play' evident in soldier's death
item.description: KUANTAN: A soldier died at the Tengku Ampuan Afzan Hospital yesterday (Feb 19) after he was found unconscious at the 10th Mile Army Camp here.

item.title: Trott unsure of future but England coaching role appeals
item.description: KABUL: Jonathan Trott enjoyed a victory in his last game in charge of Afghanistan on Thursday and while he does not know what the future holds he said he would jump at the chance to coach England if the opportunity arose.

item.title: Indonesian crew member dies in cruise ship fire off Singapore
item.description: SINGAPORE: A fire on a Singapore-bound cruise ship killed one crew member and prompted the evacuation of hundreds of passengers, the city-state’s maritime and port authority said Friday.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Veteran actress Norlia Ghani recalls P. Ramlee's bold marriage proposal at age 17
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Veteran actress Norlia Ghani has opened up about a long-kept secret involving the legendary Seniman Agung, the late Tan Sri P. Ramlee.

item.title: Pakistan turmoil boosts Speedy Tigers' hockey World Cup qualifying hopes
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The internal turmoil within the Pakistan men’s hockey team could boost Malaysia’s chances of beating the former Olympic champions at the World Cup Qualifiers in Ismailia, Egypt, on March 1-7.

item.title: "Limit on PM's tenure starts with me," says Anwar
item.description: KUALA LANGAT: Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim said the proposed law to limit the Prime Minister’s tenure will apply to him first.

item.title: Astro shares rally 40pct on heaviest trading in nearly three years
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Astro Malaysia Holdings Bhd leapt to the top of Bursa Malaysia’s most active list, after its shares rallied 40 per cent on the heaviest volume in nearly three years.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Jet Li shares rare family mahjong moment during CNY
item.description: SINGAPORE: While fans are more accustomed to seeing martial arts icon Jet Li dishing out lightning-fast strikes in high-stakes fight scenes, this Chinese New Year saw the legend mastering a different kind of shuffle: mahjong tiles.

item.title: Playground gun attack in Mexico kills two, wounds eight
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO DEL RINCÓN, Mexico: Gunfire tore through a busy playground in central Mexico, killing two people and wounding eight, authorities said Wednesday, as witnesses recounted a horrifying scene of mothers screaming and children fleeing in panic.
